description: This Java class implements a substitution strategy for modifying subjects within a ModifySubjects command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It performs substitution of subjects based on provided headers and substitution algorithms, ensuring updates only when changes occur.

classes.name: ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy to handle substitution logic for ModifySubjects commands.

methods.name: ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the substitution strategy with the ModifySubjects class.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes substitution on the Subjects within a ModifySubjects object, returning the same object if no change occurs or a new modified object if substitution results in a change.
